OUR STORY
The Owners
1stAnd10BarberShop.com
Built on
passion,
precision &
community.

At 1st & 10 Barber Shop, we believe that a great haircut can make a big difference in how you feel. That's why we're passionate about providing our clients with the highest quality haircuts and grooming services.

Our experienced barbers are dedicated to ensuring that you leave our shop feeling your best — every single time.

✂️
Our Services

Haircuts · Beard Trims · Hot Towel Shaves · Fades · Designs · Afros · Graphics · Styling & more. Classic or modern — we've got you covered.

🏈
Our Team

10 skilled barbers across 2 locations. Years of experience, committed to ongoing education and always up-to-date on the latest styles and techniques.

⭐
Our Promise

We use only the best products and techniques. Walk in or book online — you'll leave looking and feeling your best, guaranteed.

Repping the brand

From custom patches to branded gear — 1st & 10 is more than a haircut. It's a culture.
